channel.title: CreArtBox · News
channel.description: Season announcements, notes from the road, and what the ensemble is working on now.

item.title: The printed programme for Currents, before the night
item.description: The booklet for 30 October can be read page by page on the site, or downloaded, a month before the concert.

item.title: Five days at the Kuopio Conservatory
item.description: Guillermo Laporta and Josefina Urraca teach in Finland from 5 to 9 October, and play one public concert next door at the Music Centre.

item.title: Eleven works this season came through the open call
item.description: More than in any season before, and in April an entire evening is given over to them.

item.title: CreArtBox announces its twelfth season
item.description: Four productions at The DiMenna Center, eleven works from the open call, one world premiere, touring dates in Illinois, Kentucky and the Hudson Valley, a residency in Finland, and the seventh Festival ADAR in Asturias.
